name: Capella
tagline: A quadruple golden system — two giant stars orbiting so close they nearly touch.
history: Capella, the 'little she-goat,' is not one star but four: a bright pair of yellow giants locked in a 104-day orbit, circled far out by a pair of faint red dwarfs. The giants are close enough that interferometers can resolve their surfaces — Capella was the first star measured that way, and among the first imaged as a real disk. Its golden winter gleam has steered sailors since antiquity.
